spec.title: Selection on v3 §20’s conditions
spec.input: a run where the camera moves, with the whole Phase 4–7 stack live beneath it
spec.expected: keyframes inserted when one of v3 §20’s conditions is met and not otherwise
spec.passCriteria: >= 15 decisions judged; every insertion's recorded reason re-derivable from the inputs recorded beside it; no insertion inside 500 ms of the previous one; no gap longer than 5000 ms; and at least one insertion on a geometric condition
spec.failureCondition: an insertion whose reason its own numbers do not support; or a run in which every insertion is the maximum-interval heartbeat, which is a metronome wearing this phase’s labels

testResults.observed: 55 keyframe(s) over 606 decisions — {"FIRST":5,"TOO_SOON":215,"DISPLACEMENT":36,"NO_CONDITION":336,"HEARTBEAT":4,"QUALITY":10}; 46 on a geometric condition, longest gap 5086.3 ms
testResults.reason: every insertion’s reason re-derives from its own inputs, both of v3 §20’s intervals held, and the store was fed by the geometry rather than by the clock

spec.title: The stationary case
spec.input: a segment during which Phase 4’s independent scene-shift search reported STATIC — the image is not moving
spec.expected: the selector inserts nothing but the maximum-interval heartbeat, while a metronome firing at the minimum interval keeps inserting
spec.passCriteria: >= 15 decisions while STATIC; no insertion during them on a geometric condition; and the metronome twin ahead by at least 5x over the same decisions
spec.failureCondition: a keyframe inserted on a still camera for a geometric reason; or a count equal to the metronome’s, which is a metronome

testResults.observed: over 315 static decisions the selector inserted 4 (0 geometric) and the metronome 51 — 12.75x
testResults.reason: on a camera that is not moving the two selectors part company, which is the one thing a schedule cannot imitate: they saw the same frames and disagreed about which of them were worth keeping

spec.title: Bounded, and able to let go
spec.input: a run long enough to fill the store
spec.expected: at most 30 keyframes, with every eviction naming what went and why
spec.passCriteria: the store never exceeded 30; every eviction carries a reason; the comparison partner is never the one evicted; an eviction occurred or the run reports the store never filled; and eviction preserved viewpoint coverage at least as well as dropping the oldest would have, on the majority of evictions
spec.failureCondition: a store above the bound; an eviction with no reason; or the current keyframe evicted, which would leave the selector comparing against a view it had discarded

testResults.observed: 30/30 at its fullest, 25 eviction(s), 25 of them at least as well spread as dropping the oldest
testResults.reason: the bound held, every eviction said what went and why, and what went was the most redundant viewpoint rather than simply the oldest — which is the difference between a store that describes the room and one that describes the last few seconds

spec.title: What travels with a keyframe
spec.expected: observations with stable ids, and each keyframe’s own intrinsics (§H.0)
spec.passCriteria: every keyframe carries >= 20 observations with unique ids; every keyframe’s K re-derives from the frame geometry it recorded; consecutive keyframes share enough observations to form a pair, or the record says why not; and SCALE: LOCAL_UNITS throughout
spec.failureCondition: a keyframe with no observations, or one whose intrinsics belong to a different frame geometry than the one it was taken at

testResults.observed: 55 keyframe(s); median 126 observation(s) shared with the previous one (0 decision(s) below the floor of 20); 0 intrinsics mismatch(es)
testResults.reason: each keyframe carries the observations Phase 9 will pair and the K it was taken under, re-derived from its own recorded geometry rather than borrowed from the current frame

spec.title: The condition this phase refuses
spec.expected: v3 §20's 0.1 local-unit translation condition carried as a value marked UNMEASURED, with the missing scale named and a number beside it
spec.passCriteria: the translation condition appears in every decision with its threshold and the state UNMEASURED; no insertion cites it; the angle the translation direction moved is measured and reported; and SCALE: LOCAL_UNITS throughout
spec.failureCondition: a decision that fired on a translation magnitude — there is no such magnitude in this build, so any is fabricated

testResults.observed: TRANSLATION carried as UNMEASURED against v3 §20's 0.1 local unit; it fired 0 time(s); the direction moved 0.33° over 400 sample(s)
testResults.reason: the condition is present as a value rather than absent as a field, it never fires, and the refusal carries a number: the direction is measurable and its magnitude is the quantity that does not exist

condition.name: TRANSLATION
condition.note: v3 §20 asks for a translation **magnitude**. Phase 6 recovers a unit direction with SCALE: LOCAL_UNITS, because v3 §15 and v4 §18 forbid a monocular camera claiming a distance — so there is no such magnitude in this build and this condition never fires. DISPLACEMENT below is the same quantity in the units the platform can produce

spec.title: Staleness
spec.input: the store, over a run in which features are lost and replaced
spec.expected: a keyframe that has stopped describing anything the current frame can be related to is marked stale and is not used as the comparison partner
spec.passCriteria: the surviving-observation fraction is measured for every retained keyframe; a keyframe below 0.25 is not used as the partner; and either at least one keyframe went stale or the run reports that none did
spec.failureCondition: a stale keyframe used as the comparison partner; or a keyframe retired for being old rather than for having stopped describing anything

testResults.observed: 26 of 30 keyframe(s) stale now, 29 at the most; median surviving fraction 31.4% over 400 sample(s)
testResults.reason: staleness is measured from surviving observations and from nothing else — v4 §20 forbids using old information blindly, and it does not say that old information is bad: a keyframe whose points are all still visible is as useful as when it was taken

controller.note: Every decision carries the median worker latency and the budget it was compared against. The controller reads no clock of its own — only the timestamps on the samples it is given (§59).

segmentLog.note: The timeline is cut wherever load injection was switched on or off. FRAME-001 reads the longest unstressed segment; stressed segments are measured and reported but never counted toward continuity.

crossCheckDetail.note: Each pair is one video frame measured twice: on the main thread with an independent 64x48 readback, and in the worker on the pixels the pipeline actually delivered. The readback costs what §H.1 measured, which is why it runs at 1 Hz and is excluded from the pipeline UI cost in FRAME-005.

pipeline.note: Frames declined by rate pacing (pacedOut) are the scheduler working as designed and are not drops. Frames declined because the worker was busy (backpressured) are deliberate too. Only `lost` counts frames that were handed over and never came back, and only that is held against FRAME-001.

refill.note: What §11's refill produced each frame and why each point was or was not admitted. Declined-too-close means the point is already being tracked, which is a healthy tracker rather than a failing one; declined-out-of-reach means it sat where the solver's window cannot cover it. Without the split, a population below §11's minimum cannot be told apart from a detector that found little.

flow.note: Motion classes are measured from the image by an integer SAD translation search on the pyramid’s top level, which shares no code with the Lucas-Kanade solver and never reads the feature list. `tracked` counts only points carried forward from the previous frame; `redetected` counts what §11’s refill added, and the two are never summed into a survival figure — a refill can top the population back up while the tracker is losing everything.

current.reason: 80 inliers at ratio 1, over v3 §14's usable 30/0.35. Not GOOD: inliers 80 <= 100

injectedOutliers.note: GEO-003. The harness displaces a known fraction of the correspondences by a known amount and hands the verifier the set with no marking. `medianRecall` is the fraction of the harness’s own outliers the verifier rejected — the one number in this phase a stage that returns its input cannot produce, because returning its input scores exactly 0 while satisfying every count-based criterion v3 §14 names.

planarHandling.note: v3 §16. Both models are fitted on every judged frame, never skipped as an optimisation: the fundamental matrix is the weaker constraint and normally admits at least as many points, so the homography reaching it is the signal that the scene is planar. Phase 6 lowers translation confidence there, because an Essential matrix decomposed from a planar scene is degenerate and yields a pose that looks entirely reasonable.

current.reason: 80 of 80 correspondences in front of both cameras; rotation alone leaves 40.3 px, which the translation direction accounts for. Direction only — a monocular camera has no scale (v3 §15, v4 §18)

withheld: IMUConsistency — v3 §19 lists it, and Phase 6 withholds it on purpose: it is the instrument POSE-002 scores this phase against, and a confidence that consumed the gyroscope could not then be checked against it (§H.7). Phase 7 adds it.

intrinsics.note: v3 §15: INTRINSICS: ESTIMATED. Safari exposes no focal length, so K is derived from an assumed field of view and every record says so. §H.0 is why it is recomputed per frame rather than read once: rotating the device swaps the frame dimensions on the same track, and fx, fy, cx, cy all change with them.

sensitivity.note: How far the pose moves when the assumed focal length is scaled by ±20%. This is the other half of being allowed to say INTRINSICS: ESTIMATED — a quantity that barely moves does not depend on the guess, and one that moves does.

gyroscope.note: POSE-002. The gyroscope is an instrument here and never an input: v3 §19 lists IMU consistency among the confidence terms and Phase 6 withholds it on purpose, because a confidence that consumed the gyroscope could not then be checked against it. Angles only — rotationRate is in the device frame and the camera frame differs by a fixed rotation nobody has measured; an angle is invariant under that, an axis is not.

planarHandling.note: v3 §16. A planar scene is decomposed from the homography, never the Essential matrix, and its translation confidence is lowered by the number of candidates cheirality could not separate — generically two on a plane, so 1/2. Counted, not assumed. The two confidence medians are reported and NOT compared across classes: each is a minimum over several terms, and on a frame with a thin population the binding term is not the planar one, so the cross-class comparison measures the population rather than v3 §16. The candidate counts beside them are what the penalty is made of.

failClosed.note: POSE-004. A camera that turned without moving produces large, well-conditioned image motion and no translation at all; the direction fitted to it would be noise with a unit length. Decided from the correspondences — what rotation alone leaves unexplained — rather than from the decomposition.

injectedRotation.note: POSE-005, and the one number in this phase a stage returning a constant pose cannot produce — it scores exactly 0.00° while satisfying every other numeric criterion. The harness applies K Rj K^-1 to the second view, which is exactly the camera having turned by Rj, and re-runs the whole chain on a set handed over unmarked. The control is the same set unmodified: without it a solver returning noise would also pass.

fusion.positionReason: the accelerometer reports m/s² and Phase 6’s translation is a unit direction in LOCAL_UNITS with no scale, so fusing them needs the scale — which is exactly the quantity a monocular camera does not have (v3 §15, §17; v4 §18, §19)
fusion.velocityReason: velocity is refused for the same reason as position: integrating an acceleration gives a velocity in m/s, and there is nothing in LOCAL_UNITS to correct it against (v3 §17, §18). It is absent rather than reported as zero
fusion.accelBiasReason: accelerometer bias is not observable without position observability, and position is refused — so estimating it would be estimating a quantity nothing can correct (v3 §18)

conditions.note: v3 §20 asks for a translation **magnitude**.
